Package net.boricj.bft.ctf

Class CTFStringSection

java.lang.Object
net.boricj.bft.ctf.CTFStringSection
public class CTFStringSection extends Object
Represents the CTF string section. Contains null-terminated strings referenced throughout the CTF data.
